blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Icons of Change International Awards 2026 is set to recognize journalists, diplomats, business and healthcare leaders as well as peace advocates on Dec. 5. The program, which will culminate the annual Icons of Change International Week for Changemakers, honors those whose work align with the United Nations’ 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). “The initiative reflects the growing importance of multidisciplinary leadership in addressing contemporary global challenges. It recognizes that progress in societies and institutions requires contributions from different professions, sectors and geographical regions,” the Icons of Change organization said in a statement.
